  SELECT p.cash_day,
         CASE WHEN r.net_allowed = 1 THEN MAX(SUM(p.signed_cents), 0) ELSE SUM(MAX(p.signed_cents, 0)) END AS receipts,
         CASE WHEN r.net_allowed = 1 THEN MAX(-SUM(p.signed_cents), 0) ELSE SUM(-MIN(p.signed_cents, 0)) END AS repayments
  FROM treasury_post AS p
  JOIN facility_rule AS r ON r.facility_code = p.facility_code
  GROUP BY p.cash_day, p.facility_code, r.net_allowed
)
SELECT cash_day, SUM(receipts) AS receipts_cents, SUM(repayments) AS repayments_cents
FROM facility_day
GROUP BY cash_day
ORDER BY cash_day",
  "decision-opening-stock-with-lost-rentals-and-returns": "WITH RECURSIVE stock_run(opening_bikes, pulse_no, inventory, penalty_points) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT opening_bikes, 0, opening_bikes, 0
  FROM stock_option
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.opening_bikes, p.pulse_no,
         MIN(c.dock_count, MAX(0, s.inventory + p.bike_delta)),
         s.penalty_points + MAX(0, -(s.inventory + p.bike_delta)) * c.rental_points
                          + MAX(0, s.inventory + p.bike_delta - c.dock_count) * c.return_points
  FROM stock_run AS s
  JOIN demand_pulse AS p ON p.pulse_no = s.pulse_no + 1
  CROSS JOIN service_card AS c
)

FROM stock_run AS s
CROSS JOIN service_card AS c
WHERE s.pulse_no = (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(pulse_no), 0) FROM demand_pulse)
ORDER BY s.penalty_points, s.opening_bikes
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-order-overlapping-quality-inspections": "WITH scores AS (
  SELECT a.code || b.code || c.code AS inspection_order,
         SUM(s.frequency * CASE
           WHEN INSTR(s.detects, a.code) > 0 THEN a.minutes
           WHEN INSTR(s.detects, b.code) > 0 THEN a.minutes + b.minutes
           ELSE a.minutes + b.minutes + c.minutes
         END) AS weighted_minutes,
         SUM(s.frequency) AS detectable_count
  FROM inspections AS a
  JOIN inspections AS b ON b.code <> a.code
  JOIN inspections AS c ON c.code <> a.code AND c.code <> b.code
  CROSS JOIN scenarios AS s
  WHERE s.detects <> ''
  GROUP BY a.code, b.code, c.code

WITH facility_day AS (
  SELECT p.cash_day,
         CASE WHEN r.net_allowed = 1 THEN MAX(SUM(p.signed_cents), 0) ELSE SUM(MAX(p.signed_cents, 0)) END AS receipts,
         CASE WHEN r.net_allowed = 1 THEN MAX(-SUM(p.signed_cents), 0) ELSE SUM(-MIN(p.signed_cents, 0)) END AS repayments
  FROM treasury_post AS p
  JOIN facility_rule AS r ON r.facility_code = p.facility_code
  GROUP BY p.cash_day, p.facility_code, r.net_allowed
)
SELECT cash_day, SUM(receipts) AS receipts_cents, SUM(repayments) AS repayments_cents
FROM facility_day
GROUP BY cash_day
ORDER BY cash_day

WITH RECURSIVE stock_run(opening_bikes, pulse_no, inventory, penalty_points) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT opening_bikes, 0, opening_bikes, 0
  FROM stock_option
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.opening_bikes, p.pulse_no,
         MIN(c.dock_count, MAX(0, s.inventory + p.bike_delta)),
         s.penalty_points + MAX(0, -(s.inventory + p.bike_delta)) * c.rental_points
                          + MAX(0, s.inventory + p.bike_delta - c.dock_count) * c.return_points
  FROM stock_run AS s
  JOIN demand_pulse AS p ON p.pulse_no = s.pulse_no + 1
  CROSS JOIN service_card AS c
)
SELECT s.opening_bikes, s.inventory AS closing_bikes, s.penalty_points, c.source_id
FROM stock_run AS s
CROSS JOIN service_card AS c
WHERE s.pulse_no = (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(pulse_no), 0) FROM demand_pulse)
ORDER BY s.penalty_points, s.opening_bikes
LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-order-overlapping-quality-inspe:
WITH scores AS (
  SELECT a.code || b.code || c.code AS inspection_order,
         SUM(s.frequency * CASE
           WHEN INSTR(s.detects, a.code) > 0 THEN a.minutes
           WHEN INSTR(s.detects, b.code) > 0 THEN a.minutes + b.minutes
           ELSE a.minutes + b.minutes + c.minutes
         END) AS weighted_minutes,
         SUM(s.frequency) AS detectable_count
  FROM inspections AS a
  JOIN inspections AS b ON b.code <> a.code
  JOIN inspections AS c ON c.code <> a.code AND c.code <> b.code
  CROSS JOIN scenarios AS s
  WHERE s.detects <> ''
  GROUP BY a.code, b.code, c.code
)
SELECT inspection_order, ROUND(1.0 * weighted_minutes / detectable_count, 3) AS expected_minutes
FROM scores
ORDER BY weighted_minutes, inspection_order COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-overnight-wagon-block-split:
SELECT e.block_qty AS east_qty, w.block_qty AS west_qty,
       e.quote_cents + w.quote_cents + CASE WHEN e.block_qty > 0 AND w.block_qty > 0 THEN m.split_cents ELSE 0 END AS payable_cents,
       e.slip_id AS east_slip, w.slip_id AS west_slip
FROM wagon_manifest AS m
JOIN yard_slip AS e ON e.yard_code = 'E'
JOIN yard_slip AS w ON w.yard_code = 'W' AND e.block_qty + w.block_qty = m.wagon_qty
ORDER BY payable_cents, east_qty DESC
LIMIT 1
